title: Frontend Developer
description: Build responsive user interfaces, work with designers and backend developers, and improve the performance and accessibility of web applications. Experience with HTML, CSS and JavaScript is useful.

title: Backend Developer
description: Develop and maintain server-side applications and APIs. Collaborate with the product team, write reliable code, and help improve database performance and application security.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Create clear, user-friendly digital experiences. Prepare wireframes and prototypes, conduct usability reviews, and collaborate with developers to deliver polished interfaces.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description: Plan and manage digital marketing campaigns, review campaign performance, coordinate content, and help grow brand awareness across online channels.

title: Financial Analyst
description: Analyze financial information, prepare reports, monitor budgets, and provide insights that support business and investment decisions.

title: Registered Nurse
description: Provide patient care, monitor patient progress, maintain accurate records, and coordinate with clinical staff while following professional care standards.

title: Graphic Designer
description: Create visual concepts for digital and print materials, collaborate with clients, and prepare design assets that follow brand guidelines.

title: Data Analyst
description: Collect, clean and analyze datasets, build reports and dashboards, and communicate useful findings to help teams make informed decisions.

title: Content Writer
description: Research topics and write clear, engaging content for websites, blogs and marketing materials while following editorial guidelines.

title: Accountant
description: Maintain financial records, prepare account reconciliations, assist with financial statements, and support accurate monthly reporting.

title: Pharmacist
description: Review prescriptions, provide medicine-related guidance, maintain pharmacy records, and support safe medication practices.

title: Mobile App Developer
description: Develop and test mobile application features, collaborate with product and design teams, and help maintain app quality across devices.
